Ava (CEO): Quick pulse from me — one-page asks for the week. TL;DR: keep private GA on track, tighten cost targets, and no surprises on reliability.

Ava (CEO): Metrics snapshot: net new hosted revenue +8% WoW, P95 latency improved 20ms, error budget burn at 3.2% (target <5%).

Ava (CEO): Three asks: 1) Product — finalize canary plan for EU private tomorrow, 2) Eng — freeze any non-critical infra changes until Friday, 3) SRE — escalate any >10% error-rate spikes immediately to #eng-oncall.

Miguel (VP Product): On the canary — rollout plan is ready, will run 10% traffic -> 30% -> 100% over 48h if no regressions. Prompt set for quality checks is shared in the doc.

Priya (VP Eng): Noted. Eng will pause feature merges into main until we hit the 48h milestone. Prioritizing the model fallback path and perf regressions.

Sam (SRE): SRE checklist: health dashboards updated, automated rollback threshold set at 12% error increase, runbook pinned. If deploy triggers, page rotation will be: oncall -> eng-rotation -> exec-alert.

Sam (SRE): Quick snippet of the runbook action to confirm:
```
if error_rate > 12% for 5m:
  revert-canary()
  notify(#incidents, @priya @miguel)
  start-rollback-postmortem()
```

Jordan (Finance): Heads up — we're trimming Q3 cost target by 6% across hosted infra. Ops/Eng please review caching/batching suggestions from Optimize; they have the biggest immediate impact.

Elena (Security): Small policy update: for Private customers we need an explicit KMS rotation confirmation before GA. Legal + Security will send a template this afternoon. Please incorporate into onboarding checklist.

Ava (CEO): Thanks team. If anything blocks the canary schedule, flag it ASAP. I want one clear update in this thread by EOD with green/amber/red status.

Miguel (VP Product): Will post the canary readiness tick-boxes by 1400 PT.

Priya (VP Eng): Engineered fallback tested locally; integration tests running now, ETA 1600 PT for results.

deploy-bot: deploy/1732469001 to prod-canary started by @Priya (VP Eng) — status: queued

deploy-bot: deploy/1732469023 to prod-canary — status: success (rollout at 10%) :rocket:

Sam (SRE): Observability check: no immediate anomalies after 20m. Latency +5ms, error rate stable. Monitoring for 2h.

Ava (CEO): Great start. Keep updates concise — green/amber/red and a one-line reason. I’ll synthesize for the exec digest tomorrow.
